description:
Grant a principal a role on a flow (PUT .../permissions/{principalId}) [DISABLED: set ENABLE_WRITE_OPS=true].
Parameters: flow (required), principalId (required — AAD object id), roleName (CanEdit|CanView), environment (optional).
Uses Microsoft's unofficial api.flow.microsoft.com endpoint, which Microsoft labels unsupported; behavior may change.

environment.description: Environment id (from list_environments). Omit to use the user's default environment.

principalId.description: Azure AD object id of the user/group to grant.

name: add_flow_owner
